dialogue.zh: 霜降，是秋季的第一個節氣。
dialogue.ja: 霜降は秋の最初の節気です。

dialogue.text: Around October 23rd is Schwang Jiang, fast descent.
dialogue.zh: 大約在十月二十三日是霜降。
dialogue.ja: だいたい10月23日頃が霜降です。
dialogue.local: Around October 23rd is Schwang Jiang, fast descent.
dialogue.en: Around October 23rd is Schwang Jiang, fast descent.

dialogue.text: This is the last solar term of autumn.
dialogue.zh: 這是秋天的最後一個節氣。
dialogue.ja: これは秋の最後の二十四節気です。
dialogue.local: This is the last solar term of autumn.
dialogue.en: This is the last solar term of autumn.

dialogue.text: In the morning, the ground sparkles with white fast.
dialogue.zh: 早晨，地面閃爍著白色的霜。
dialogue.ja: 朝になると、地面が白い霜で輝いています。
dialogue.local: In the morning, the ground sparkles with white fast.
dialogue.en: In the morning, the ground sparkles with white fast.

dialogue.text: It looks like someone sprinkled sugar everywhere.
dialogue.zh: 看起來像有人灑滿了糖。
dialogue.ja: まるで誰かが砂糖をまき散らしたように見えます。
dialogue.local: It looks like someone sprinkled sugar everywhere.
dialogue.en: It looks like someone sprinkled sugar everywhere.

dialogue.text: Maple leaves are now the most brilliant red.
dialogue.zh: 楓葉現在是最鮮紅的時候。
dialogue.ja: カエデの葉は今、一番鮮やかな赤色です。
dialogue.local: Maple leaves are now the most brilliant red.
dialogue.en: Maple leaves are now the most brilliant red.

dialogue.text: Remember the poem, fast leaves are rather than spring flowers.
dialogue.zh: 記得那首詩，霜葉勝過春花。
dialogue.ja: 詩を思い出してください、「霜の葉は春の花よりも美しい」と。
dialogue.local: Remember the poem, fast leaves are rather than spring flowers.
dialogue.en: Remember the poem, fast leaves are rather than spring flowers.

dialogue.text: People eat persimmons on this day, sweet and soft.
dialogue.zh: 人們在這一天吃柿子，甜美又柔軟。
dialogue.ja: この日には人々が甘くて柔らかい柿を食べます。
dialogue.local: People eat persimmons on this day, sweet and soft.
dialogue.en: People eat persimmons on this day, sweet and soft.

dialogue.text: Fast descent is autumn's grand finale before winter ticks the stage.
dialogue.zh: 霜降是秋天的盛大結局，冬天即將登場。
dialogue.ja: 霜降は秋の華やかなフィナーレであり、冬の始まりを告げます。
dialogue.local: Fast descent is autumn's grand finale before winter ticks the stage.
dialogue.en: Fast descent is autumn's grand finale before winter ticks the stage.
